line: A soft tick for a control
why: The only take so far. Heard as a sharp high clink, sharper than the soft tick its line asks for. Kept so the app and the blockout carry a tick from the start. A softer take is due in Phase 3.
tool: ElevenLabs sound effects, POST /v1/sound-generation, the default model (eleven_text_to_sound_v2), PCM at 48 kHz
prompt: One single soft tick, a fingernail tapping a small glass bead once, very short and dry, close and detailed, glass, water and small natural things, a dark quiet room, no music, no melody, no voice

steps: low cut at 120 Hz, before the trim
trimmed 0.148 s in front and 0.182 s at the end
fade in 2 ms, fade out 30 ms
held 0.07 dB under -26 LUFS so the peak of this short sound stays within 16 dB of its class level
level: -2.07 dB to -26.07 LUFS, measured as K weighted mean square over the sound's own length (it is shorter than one 400 ms block), 0.08 s

level.measuredAs: K weighted mean square over the sound's own length (it is shorter than one 400 ms block), 0.08 s

ffmpeg.note: the meter of ffmpeg gives no loudness under 400 ms, so the level stands on the measure named in chain.level

answers.why: Numbers: one tick, 0.11 s, peak -8 dBFS, three quarters of its energy above 8 kHz. Listener on the padded copy: a sharp high metallic clink like a coin on a hard surface, one event. With the line shown it said yes. It is sharper than the soft tick the line asks for. Two takes are left.
